senses.gloss:
† घुर् घुर्. i. 6, Par.
 1. To be frightful.
 2. To sound.

† घूर् घूर्, i. 4, Ātm.
 1. To kill.
 2. To become old.
घुरघुराय घुरघुराय (a denomin. based on an imitative sound), Ātm. To rattle in the throat, Bhāg. P. 3, 30, 17.
घुर्घुराय घुर्घुराय (a denomin. based on an imitative sound), Ātm. To whistle, Suśr. 1, 104, 1.

घूर्ण् घूर्ण्, (a dialectical form of ह्वृण् in ह्वृणा, ii. 9, of ह्वृ, based on the original ह्वर्णा), i. 6, Par.; i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To reel, MBh. 10, 802.
 2. To move to and fro, MBh. 1, 2133.
 3. To roll (as the eye), Prab. 6, 5.
 4. To be uncertain, MBh. 1, 2061.
 --Caus. घूर्णय,
 1. To roll, Bhartṛ. 1, 88.
 --With अव अव, To roll, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 12. अवघूर्णित, Cast down, MBh. 9, 3239.
 --With आ आ, To wave, Mṛcch. 85, 16. आघूर्णित,
 1. Shaken, Dev. 12, 26.
 2. Rolling, Bhāg. P. 6, 1, 59.
 --With व्या वि-आ, To flutter, MBh. 7, 7301. व्याघूर्णित,
 1. Shaken, MBh. 5, 7191.
 2. Tottering, MBh. 2, 1673.
 --With परि परि, To be agitated, MBh. 1, 2089.
 --With वि वि, To stagger, MBh. 11, 522; to shake, 3, 11141. विघूर्णित, Revolved, Bhāg. P. 3, 19, 3.

घूर्ण घूर्ण् + अ, adj., f. णा, Vacillating, Bhāg. P. 7, 2, 2.
 2. Shaken, Bhāg. P. 9, 10, 17.
 --Comp.
घूर्णन घूर्ण् + अन, n. and f. णा, Trembling oscillation, Gīt. 9, 11.
